The '''main headquarters''' of the manufacturing company [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Due to the company maintaining a good relationship with multiple [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] governments, the headquarters remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="AEGE">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021017web|text=''Arms & Equipment Guide'' Extras!}}</ref>
